secrets.name: SCP_JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: JWT signing key for the SCP API (min 32 chars). Generate with: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))"

secrets.name: SCP_ADMIN_KEY
secrets.description: Admin key for POST /auth/token (min 8 chars). Generate with: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(24))"

secrets.name: SCP_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET
secrets.description: Bearer token secret for SCP API admin auth (verify_admin). Used by the dashboard proxy.

secrets.name: SCP_CAPABILITY_SECRET
secrets.description: HMAC signing secret for capability tokens (GAP-09 fail-closed).

secrets.name: SCP_PC_CONTROLLER_TOKEN
secrets.description: PC controller token for /v3/pc/* and /v3/hands/* endpoints. Used by the dashboard proxy.
